faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes Sprinter 314–319 CDI use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the specification. The Sprinter 314–319 CDI from 2018 to 2022 used either the OM651 2.1-litre four-cylinder diesel or the OM642 3.0-litre V6 diesel, depending on the output level. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your van has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes Sprinter 314–319 CDI engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200 for the OM651 4-cylinder or £2,800 for the OM642 V6. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Sprinter 314–319 CDI?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM651 or the OM642 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM651 Sprinter 314–319 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace injector seals, timing chain components and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 Sprinter 314–319 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace swirl flaps, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Sprinter 314–319 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Sprinter if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Sprinter 314–319 CDI engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Sprinter 314–319 CDI owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
